The image above shows the sector of a circle centre $O$, with radius $r$ and central angle $270^{\circ}$.

The sector is joined to the triangle $ABO$.

The perimeter of the compound shape is $21\mathrm{cm}$.

Work out the value of $r$.

Leave your answer to one decimal place.
parts.solution_md:
> *Find the arc length of the sector*

$\frac{θ}{360}\times2πr\,\frac{270}{360}\times2π\timesr\,\frac{3}{2}πr$

**[M1]**

> *Find the hypotenuse of triangle *$ABO$

> *Since it is a right angled isosceles triangle, the length is*

$\sqrt{r^{2}+r^{2}}=r\sqrt{2}$

**[M1]**

> *Adding these gives the perimeter of the total shape*

$\frac{3}{2}πr+r\sqrt{2}=21$

**[M1]**

> *Factor out the *$r$* and divide*

`r ( 3 / 2 pi + sqrt( 2 ) = 21 r = (21)/(( 3 / 2 pi + sqrt( 2 )) r = 3.428...`

**[M1]**

> *Round to 1 decimal place*

$r=3.4\mathrm{cm}$

**[A1]**
